title: Ilmiy maqola o‘qish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilidagi ilmiy maqolalarni tez va samarali o‘qiy olasiz: IMRaD tuzilishi, skimming va scanning, dalil va da’volarni ajratish, akademik lug‘at va ehtiyotkor (hedging) til.

scenes.title: Ilmiy maqola o‘qish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda panellarni boshqarishni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilidagi ilmiy maqolalarni o‘qishni o‘rganamiz — bu IELTS Academic Reading va har qanday universitet yoki kasbiy tadqiqotning asosi. Maqsad — har bir so‘zni o‘qish emas, balki maqsadli o‘qish: tuzilishni bilish, skimming va scanning, dalil va da’volarni ajratish. Dars oxirida maqolani o‘n-o‘n besh daqiqada tushunib chiqa olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson seven. Today we learn how to read academic articles efficiently: IMRaD structure, skimming and scanning, and separating claims from evidence.
scenes.say_uz: Yettinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun ilmiy maqolalarni samarali o‘qishni o‘rganamiz: IMRaD tuzilishi, skimming va scanning, hamda dalil va da’volarni ajratish.

scenes.title: Nega oddiy o‘qish yetmaydi: deep reading vs strategic reading

examples.t: A research article is a machine for transmitting findings — read it like an engineer, not a poet.
examples.uz: Ilmiy maqola — natijalarni uzatish mashinasi — uni shoir emas, muhandis kabi o‘qing.

scenes.say_native: Roman o‘qimasangiz, maqola o‘qiysiz — bu ikki xil jarayon. Roman — so‘zma-so‘z — maqsad — lazzat. Maqola — tuzilma asosida — maqsad — ma’lumotni chiqarib olish — extract. Ilmiy maqolaning har bir bo‘limi aniq savolga javob beradi: nima muammo, qanday o‘rganildi, nima topildi, nima anglatadi. Agar siz tuzilmani bilsangiz — abstract’ni o‘qib, so‘ng natijalarga sakrab, kerakli raqamni scanning qilib topasiz — vaqtingiz tejaladi. Eslab qoling: maqola — muallif bilan dialog emas, balki ma’lumotlar ombori — kerakli javonni oching.
scenes.say: Reading a novel is word by word; reading an article is structure first. The goal is to extract findings fast, not to admire every sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Romainan o‘qish — so‘zma-so‘z; maqolani o‘qish — avval tuzilma. Maqsad — har bir gapni hayratda qoldirish emas, natijalarni tez chiqarib olish.

scenes.title: Maqola anatomiyasi: IMRaD + abstract + references

examples.t: The abstract reported a 12 % improvement with the new protocol.
examples.uz: Abstract’da yangi protokolda 12 foiz yaxshilanish qayd etilgan.
Metodlar: 240 ishtirokchi, tasodifiy tanlangan, ikki tomonlama ko‘r, 12 hafta.

scenes.say_native: Deyarli har qanday eksperimental ilmiy maqola IMRaD degan tuzilishga amal qiladi. I — Introduction — kirish — muammo va maqsad: “This study examines…” — bu tadqiqot …ni o‘rganadi. M — Methods — metodlar — qanday o‘rganildi: ishtirokchilar, dizayn, davomiyligi — “240 participants, randomised, 12 weeks” — 240 ishtirokchi, tasodifiy, 12 hafta. R — Results — natijalar — faqat raqamlar va jadvallar. D — Discussion — muhokama — natijalar nimani anglatadi, chegaralar, kelajak tadqiqotlari. Bulardan oldin — Abstract — annotatsiya — butun maqola 150-250 so‘zda — ko‘pincha uni o‘qib, maqola sizga kerak-kerak emasligini bilasiz. Oxirida — References — havolalar — dalillarni tekshirish uchun. Eslab qoling: IMRaD — to‘g‘ri savol, to‘g‘ri javon.
scenes.say: Most experimental articles follow IMRaD: Introduction sets the problem, Methods explain how, Results present the numbers, Discussion interprets them. The abstract previews all four in under 250 words.
scenes.say_uz: Aksariyat eksperimental maqolalar IMRaD’ga amal qiladi: Introduction muammoni belgilaydi, Methods qanday qilingani, Results raqamlar, Discussion ularning ma’nosi. Abstract to‘rttasini 250 so‘zdan kam ichida ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: IMRaD bo‘limlarini tanish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta parchani to‘g‘ri bo‘limga biriktiring. Birinchi: “240 participants were recruited and randomised…” — qaysi bo‘lim? Ikkinchi: “Group A improved by 12 %, while Group B showed no change…” — qaysi? Uchinchi: “This may be due to seasonal variation…” — qaysi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting — har birida bo‘lim nomini ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Match each excerpt to its section: one, 240 participants were recruited and randomised. Two, Group A improved by twelve per cent. Three, this may be due to seasonal variation. Name the sections in English.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir parchani bo‘limiga biriktiring: bir, 240 ishtirokchi jalb qilindi va tasodifiy qilindi. Ikki, A guruhi o‘n ikki foizga yaxshilandi. Uch, bu mavsumiy o‘zgarish tufayli bo‘lishi mumkin. Bo‘limlarni ingliz tilida nomlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: IMRaD mashqi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — Methods — ishtirokchilar va dizayn haqida. Ikkinchi — Results — raqamlar — “Group A improved by 12 %” — faqat dalil. Uchinchi — Discussion — “This may be due to seasonal variation” — talqin va ehtiyotkor taxmin. Eslab qoling: parchada raqam bo‘lsa — Results, sabab bo‘lsa — Discussion, qanday qilingani yozilgan bo‘lsa — Methods.
scenes.say: Answers: the first is Methods, the second is Results, the third is Discussion. Numbers mean Results, reasons mean Discussion, procedures mean Methods.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: birinchisi Methods, ikkinchisi Results, uchinchisi Discussion. Raqam — Results, sabab — Discussion, tartib — Methods.

scenes.title: Skimming: 60 soniyalik umumiy o‘qish

examples.t: Read the abstract, then jump to the conclusion, then decide.
examples.uz: Abstract’ni o‘qing, keyin yakunga sakrab, keyin qaror qiling.

scenes.say_native: Skimming — umumiy ma’noni tez olish — maqsad: “bu maqola menga kerakmi?” degan savolga javob. 60 soniyalik tartib: birinchi — sarlavha va abstract — mavzu va asosiy natija — 15 soniya. Ikkinchi — har paragraf ochilishidagi bir-ikki gap — “topic sentences” — 25 soniya. Uchinchi — jadvallar va grafiklar sarlavhalari — 10 soniya. To‘rtinchi — conclusion’ning birinchi ikki gapi — yakuniy javob — 10 soniya. Hech qachon birinchi o‘qishda references’ga kirmang — kerak bo‘lganda keladi. Skimming’dan keyin siz bilasiz: maqola chuqur o‘qishga arzirmi yoki yo‘qmi.
scenes.say: Skimming is speed reading for gist: title, abstract, topic sentences, table captions, and the first two lines of the conclusion — sixty seconds, then decide whether to read deeply.
scenes.say_uz: Skimming — ma’noni tez olish uchun tez o‘qish: sarlavha, abstract, topic sentences, jadval nomlar hamda conclusion’ning birinchi ikki qatori — oltmish soniya — keyin chuqur o‘qish-chi, yo‘q-mi qaror qiling.

scenes.title: Scanning: aniq faktni qidirib topish
board: Kalit so‘z: ism, yil, raqam, birlik

examples.t: Scan for “12 %” — don’t read the whole paragraph.
examples.uz: “12 %” ni scanning qiling — butun paragrafni o‘qimang.

scenes.say_native: Scanning — aniq ma’lumotni qidirib topish: ism, sana, raqam, birlik, kalit atama. Texnika: paragrafni o‘qimang — ko‘zingizni ustun bo‘ylab pastga siljiting — “search” rejimida — kalit so‘zni topgan zahoti o‘qishni to‘xtatib, shu gapni o‘qing. IELTS Listening emas — bu IELTS Reading savollari uchun asosiy strategiya — avval savol, keyin matnda shu so‘zni toping — “Where in the text” deyilganda. Masalan: “What was the improvement in Group A?” — savoldagi “Group A” va “improvement” — scanning kalitlari — matnda shu ikki so‘z yonma-yon qayerda ekanini toping. Eslab qoling: skimming — ma’no, scanning — fakt.
scenes.say: Scanning is searching: slide your eyes down the page for a name, year, number or keyword — stop and read only when you find it. Ask the question first, then hunt the keyword.
scenes.say_uz: Scanning — qidiruv: sahifa bo‘ylab ism, yil, raqam yoki kalit so‘zni qidirib ko‘zingizni siljiting — topganingizda to‘xtab, faqat shu gapni o‘qing. Avval savol, keyin kalit so‘zni qidiring.

scenes.title: Skimming va scanning mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat uchun to‘g‘ri strategiyani tanlang. Birinchi: “Maqolaning asosiy g‘oyasi nima?” — skimming yoki scanning? Ikkinchi: “Necha ishtirokchi qatnashdi?” — qaysi? Uchinchi: “Tadqiqotning asosiy natijasi nima?” — qaysi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting — va nima uchun shunday tanlaganingizni qisqacha tushuntiring.
scenes.say: Choose the right strategy: one, what is the main idea. Two, how many participants were involved. Three, what was the main finding. Answer in English and justify briefly.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri strategiyani tanlang: bir, asosiy g‘oya nima. Ikki, necha ishtirokchi qatnashdi. Uch, asosiy natija nima. Ingliz tilida javob bering va qisqacha asoslang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: skimming va scanning
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — skimming — g‘oyani tez olish. Ikkinchi — scanning — “participants” so‘zi bilan raqamni qidiring — Methods bo‘limida. Uchinchi — skimming — abstract yoki conclusion’da asosiy natija. Farqni yodda tuting: skimming — butun matn syujetini olish, scanning — bitta faktga borish. IELTS’da ikkalasi bir maqolada almashinib ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Answers: main idea — skimming; participant numbers — scanning for the word participants; main finding — skimming the abstract or conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: asosiy g‘oya — skimming; ishtirokchilar soni — scanning; asosiy natija — abstract yoki conclusion’ni skimming qilish.

scenes.title: Da’vo va dalil: claim va evidence

examples.t: We found that the new protocol cut recovery time by 30 %.
examples.uz: Biz yangi protokolning tiklanish vaqtini 30 foizga qisqartirishini aniqladik.

examples.t: According to Smith et al. (2023), the effect is consistent across populations.
examples.uz: Smith va hamkorlariga (2023) ko‘ra, ta’sir turli aholi guruhlarida barqaror.

scenes.say_native: Har bir ilmiy maqola da’volar va dalillardan iborat. Claim — da’vo — muallif nima deb hisoblaydi: “X improves Y” — X Y ni yaxshilaydi — bu hali isbot emas. Evidence — dalil — da’voni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan narsa: raqamlar, jadvallar, grafiklar, statistik testlar, iqtibos havolar. Dalil tillari: “We found that…” — biz aniqladik — “The results show…” — natijalar ko‘rsatadi — “According to Smith et al. (2023)…” — Smith va hamkorlariga ko‘ra. O‘quvchi vazifasi: har bir da’voga “qaysi dalil?” deb so‘rash — dalilsiz da’vo — fikr, isbot emas. Eslab qoling: maqolani o‘qish — dalilni da’vodan ajratish mashqi.
scenes.say: Separate claims from evidence. Claims say what the author believes; evidence — numbers, tables, citations — supports them. Ask of every claim: what evidence backs this?
scenes.say_uz: Da’voni dalildan ajrating. Da’volar — muallif nimaga ishonishini aytadi; dalil — raqamlar, jadvallar, iqtiboslar. Har bir da’vodan so‘rang: bunga qaysi dalil tayanch bo‘ladi?

scenes.title: Da’vo yoki dalil? mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni da’vo yoki dalil deb belgilang. Birinchi: “Our method cuts costs by 20 %” — da’vo yoki dalil? — raqam bor, lekin kimning raqami — muallifningmi — agar jadvalga tayanmasa — hali da’vo. Ikkinchi: “This is a promising direction” — bu da’vo — sub’ektiv baholash. Uchinchi: “Table 2 shows a 20 % reduction across three hospitals” — dalil — jadval + qiyosiy tasdiq. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Classify as claim or evidence: one, our method cuts costs by twenty per cent. Two, this is a promising direction. Three, Table 2 shows a twenty per cent reduction across three hospitals. Explain in English.
scenes.say_uz: Da’vo yoki dalil ekanini belgilang: bir, bizning usulimiz xarajatlarni yigirma foizga kamaytiradi. Ikki, bu istiqbolli yo‘nalish. Uch, 2-jadval uchta kasalxonada yigirma foiz kamayishni ko‘rsatadi. Ingliz tilida izohlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: da’vo yoki dalil
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — da’vo — raqamni o‘zi dalil qilmaydi — dalil — jadvallar, testlar, havolalar. Ikkinchi — da’vo — “promising” — kelajakka ishora — hech qanday raqamsiz. Uchinchi — dalil — jadvalga asoslangan aniq qiyosiy natija. Eslab qoling: dalil — tekshirilishi mumkin; da’vo — ishonchni talab qiladi. Ilmiy o‘qishning yuragi shu farq.
scenes.say: Answers: the first is a claim until verified in a table; the second is a subjective claim; the third is evidence — a verifiable, comparative result.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: birinchisi jadvalda tekshirilmaguncha da’vo; ikkinchisi sub’ektiv da’vo; uchinchisi dalil — tekshirilishi mumkin bo‘lgan qiyosiy natija.

scenes.title: So‘zma-so‘z o‘qish tuzog‘i
board: ✓ Abstract → Results → kerak bo‘lsa boshqa bo‘lim

examples.t: Nobody reads a journal article from line one to the last reference.
examples.uz: Hech kim jurnal maqolasini birinchi qatordan oxirgi havolagacha o‘qimaydi.

scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — maqolani roman kabi boshidan oxirigacha so‘zma-so‘z o‘qish — to‘rt soat ketdi, ma’lumot nol. To‘g‘ri tartib: abstract — natijalar — muhokama — kerak bo‘lsagina kirish va metodlar. References — faqat dalilni tekshirish kerak bo‘lganda — birinchi o‘qishda emas. Yana bir tuzoq: noma’lum so‘zning ustiga soatlab o‘tirish — kontekstda ma’nosini taxmin qiling — diqqat asosiy da’volarda bo‘lsin. Eslab qoling: ingliz tilidagi maqola o‘qish — to‘g‘ri ketma-ketlik, not to‘g‘ri xotirjamlik.
scenes.say: Never read an article from line one to the last reference. Read the abstract, then the results, then the discussion; chase references only when you need to verify.
scenes.say_uz: Hech qachon maqolani birinchi qatordan oxirgi havolagacha o‘qimang. Abstract’ni, keyin natijalarni, keyin muhokamani o‘qing; havolalarni faqat tekshirish kerak bo‘lganda kuzating.

scenes.title: Akademik lug‘at: formal so‘zlar va hedging

examples.t: The data suggest a possible link, though causation is unclear.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotlar bog‘liqlik ehtimolini bildiradi, ammo sabab-oqibat noaniq.

scenes.say_native: Ilmiy ingliz tili uchta xususiyatga ega. Birinchisi — formal sinonimlar: “however” — ammo — “but” o‘rniga; “therefore” — shuning uchun — “so” o‘rniga; “nevertheless” — shunday bo‘lsa-da; “furthermore” — bundan tashqari. Ikkinchisi — “significant” so‘zining maxsus ma’nosi — “muhim” emas, “statistik jihatdan ahamiyatli” — “p < 0.05” bilan birga keladi. Uchinchisi — hedging — ehtiyotkorlik tili: “may”, “might”, “suggests”, “appears to”, “tends to” — hech qachon to‘liq ishonch — “This proves…” o‘rniga “The data suggest…”. Bu immunitet emas, ilmiy halollik — olimlar dalil darajasiga mos so‘z ishlatadi. Eslab qoling: hedging — noaniqlik emas, aniqlikning bir turi.
scenes.say: Academic English three ways: formal synonyms — however, therefore, nevertheless; significant means statistically significant; and hedging — may, might, suggests — matching confidence to evidence.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik ingliz tili uch ko‘rinishda: formal sinonimlar — however, therefore, nevertheless; significant — statistik ahamiyatli; va hedging — may, might, suggests — ishonchni dalilga mos tutish.

scenes.title: Akademik uslubga aylantirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta norasmiy iborani akademikga aylantiring. Birinchi: “but the results were unclear” — “however” bilan. Ikkinchi: “This proves the method works” — “The data suggest…” hedging bilan. Uchinchi: “a lot of participants” — “a substantial number of participants” yoki “a considerable proportion” — bilan. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Convert to academic style: one, but the results were unclear. Two, this proves the method works. Three, a lot of participants. Rewrite in formal academic English.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik uslubga aylantiring: bir, lekin natijalar noaniq edi. Ikki, bu usul ishlashini isbotlaydi. Uch, ko‘plab ishtirokchilar. Formal akademik ingliz tilida qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: akademik uslub mashqi
board: the data suggest the method is effective
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “However, the results were unclear” — vergul bilan. Ikkinchi: “The data suggest the method is effective, though further validation is needed” — ishonch + hedging. Diqqat qiling: “data” ko‘plik — “suggest”, “data is” emas — ko‘plik — “data suggest”. Uchinchi: “A substantial number of participants” yoki “a considerable proportion of the sample” — yozing. Eslab qoling: akademik ingliz tilida — qisqa shaxsiy so‘zlar o‘rniga aniq, taxmin qilingan so‘zlar.
scenes.say: Answers: however, the results were unclear; the data suggest the method is effective; a substantial number of participants — and remember, data is plural: the data suggest.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: ammo, natijalar noaniq edi; ma’lumotlar usul samarali ekanini bildiradi; sezilarli miqdordagi ishtirokchilar — va esda tuting, data ko‘plik: the data suggest.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 1: ikki talaba maqolani muhokama qilmoqda
board: A: Did you read the study on remote work?
B: Skimmed it — productivity up, isolation up too.
A: So what’s the main claim?
B: “Hybrid works best” — but the methods are thin.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — ikki talaba yangi maqolani muhokama qilmoqda. A: “Did you read that study on remote work?” — masofadan ishlash tadqiqotini o‘qidingizmi? B: “Skimmed it — productivity up, isolation up too. The abstract says hybrid works best, but the methods are thin.” — skimming qildim, unumdorlik va izolyatsiya ham oshgan. A: “So what’s the main claim?” — xo‘sh, asosiy da’vo nima? B: “Their claim: hybrid models outperform fully remote ones. Evidence: two surveys, three hundred respondents each.” — da’volari: gibrid modellar masofadan yaxshiroq. Dalili: ikkita so‘rov, har birida uch yuz javob. A: “Worth citing — with a hedge: ‘the authors suggest’.” — iqtibos keltirishga arziydi, ehtiyotkorlik bilan. B: “Exactly.” — aynan.
scenes.say: Did you read that study on remote work? Skimmed it — productivity up, isolation up too. The abstract says hybrid works best, but the methods are thin. Their claim: hybrid models outperform remote. The evidence: two surveys, three hundred respondents each. Worth citing — with a hedge: the authors suggest.
scenes.say_uz: Masofadan ishlash haqidagi tadqiqotni o‘qidingizmi? Skimming qildim — unumdorlik oshgan, izolyatsiya ham. Abstract’da gibrid eng yaxshi deyiladi, lekin metodlar zaif. Da’volari: gibrid modellar masofadan yaxshiroq. Dalili: ikkita so‘rov, har birida uch yuz javob. Iqtibos keltirsa bo‘ladi — ehtiyotkorlik bilan: mualliflar taklif qiladilar.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: B maqolani qanday o‘qidi — to‘liqmi yoki skimming? Ikkinchi: maqolaning asosiy da’vosi nima? Uchinchi: dalil nima edi — nechta so‘rov va respondent? To‘rtinchi: B iqtibosni qanday ehtiyotkor shaklda tavsiya qildi — qaysi ibora? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: how did B read the article, what is its main claim, what evidence supports it, and how does B suggest citing it safely?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: B maqolani qanday o‘qidi, asosiy da’vosi nima, qaysi dalil qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi va B qanday ehtiyotkor iqtibosni tavsiya qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. B skimming qildi — nafaqat boshidan oxirigacha. Da’vo: gibrid modellar to‘liq masofadan ishlashdan yaxshiroq. Dalil: ikkita so‘rov, har birida uch yuz ishtirokchi — self-reported — o‘zlari aytgan ma’lumot. B iqtibosni “the authors suggest” — mualliflar taklif qiladilar — bilan ehtiyotkor shaklda tavsiya qildi — bu hedgingning amaliy namunasi. Ilmiy o‘qishda dalil zaif bo‘lsa — til ham ehtiyotkor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Answers: B skimmed; the claim is hybrid models outperform fully remote; evidence is two surveys of three hundred respondents; and B recommends the cautious citation the authors suggest.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: B skimming qildi; da’vo — gibrid modellar to‘liq masofadan yaxshiroq; dalil — ikkita, har birida uch yuz respondentli so‘rov; va B ehtiyotkor iqtibosni — mualliflar taklif qiladilar — tavsiya qildi.

scenes.title: Abstract va conclusion’ni qanday o‘qish kerak
board: Abstract = 4 qatlam: maqsad, usul, natija, xulosa

examples.t: Abstract promises a 30 % reduction; conclusion admits limits.
examples.uz: Abstract 30 foiz kamayishni va’da qiladi; conclusion chegaralarni e’tirof etadi.

scenes.say_native: Abstract va conclusion — eng muhim ikki bo‘lim. Abstract’da to‘rtta qatlamni qidiring: maqsad — “this study examines…”, usul — “240 participants…”, natija — “Group A improved 12 %…”, xulosa — “hybrid is preferable”. Conclusion’da uchta narsa: birinchi — asosiy javob — “Taken together, these findings suggest…”; ikkinchi — chegaralar — “limitations include self-reported data”; uchinchi — kelajak ishlash — “future research should…”. Professional o‘quvchi har doim shu ikkisini solishtiradi: abstract va’da qilgan narsani conclusion beribdimi? Agar yo‘q — maqola zaif. Doim abstract’dagi gapni conclusion bilan tasdiqlang.
scenes.say: Read the abstract in four layers — aim, method, result, takeaway — and the conclusion for the final answer, limitations and future work. Then check the two agree.
scenes.say_uz: Abstract’ni to‘rt qatlamda o‘qing — maqsad, usul, natija, xulosa — va conclusion’da yakuniy javob, chegaralar hamda kelajak ishni qidiring. Keyin ikkalasi mosligini tekshiring.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 2: professor va talaba abstract haqida
board: Professor: “Four moves: aim, method, result, takeaway”
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — professor va talaba. Talaba: “I don’t get what they found.” — nima topganlarini tushunmayapman. Professor: “Find four moves: the aim — ‘this study examines’; the method — ‘240 participants, randomised’; the result — ‘Group A improved 12 %’; the takeaway — ‘hybrid is preferable’. Which is missing for you?” — to‘rt harakatni toping: maqsad, usul, natija, xulosa. Qaysi yetishmayapti? Talaba: “The takeaway.” — xulosa. Professor: “Then read the conclusion: ‘Taken together, these findings suggest hybrid models benefit most knowledge workers.’ Check the limitation: ‘self-reported data’. Always compare both.” — unda conclusion’ni o‘qing va chegarani tekshiring: o‘zlari aytgan ma’lumot. Ikkalasini solishtiring.
scenes.say: Don’t read the abstract as prose. Find four moves: the aim — this study examines; the method — 240 participants; the result — Group A improved by 12 %; the takeaway — hybrid is preferable. Then compare with the conclusion, and check the limitations.
scenes.say_uz: Abstract’ni adib kabi o‘qimang. To‘rt harakatni toping: maqsad — bu tadqiqot o‘rganadi; usul — 240 ishtirokchi; natija — A guruhi 12 foizga yaxshilandi; xulosa — gibrid afzal. Keyin conclusion bilan solishtiring va chegaralarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Professor abstract’ni qanday o‘qishni tavsiya qildi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: professor talabaga abstract’ni qanday o‘qishni tavsiya qildi? Ikkinchi: to‘rt harakatni ayting — tartib bilan. Uchinchi: talabada qaysi harakat yetishmadi? To‘rtinchi: conclusion nima dedi va qaysi chegara tilga olindi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: how did the professor suggest reading the abstract, name the four moves in order, which one did the student miss, and what did the conclusion add including its limitation?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: professor abstract’ni qanday o‘qishni tavsiya qildi, to‘rt harakatni tartib bilan ayting, qaysini talaba o‘tkazib yubordi va conclusion nima qo‘shdi hamda qaysi chegara tilga olindi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: “hybrid … benefit most knowledge workers” + self-reported data
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Professor abstract’ni “proza emas, harakatlar” sifatida o‘qishni tavsiya qildi: aim — this study examines — maqsad; method — 240 participants randomised — tasodifiy; result — Group A improved 12 %; takeaway — hybrid is preferable. Talabada takeaway yetishmagandi — yakuniy xulosa. Conclusion javobi: “these findings suggest hybrid models benefit most knowledge workers” — va chegara — self-reported data — o‘zlari aytgan ma’lumot. Abstract bilan conclusion bir-birini tasdiqladi — maqola ishonchliroq. Eslab qoling: har doim ikkalasini birga o‘qing.
scenes.say: Answers: read it as four moves, not prose — aim, method, result, takeaway; the student missed the takeaway; the conclusion added hybrid benefits knowledge workers most, limited by self-reported data.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: uni to‘rt harakat sifatida o‘qing, proza emas — maqsad, usul, natija, xulosa; talabada xulosa yetishmagandi; conclusion “gibrid eng ko‘p bilim ishchilariga foyda beradi” qo‘shdi, chegara — self-reported data.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 60 soniyada skimming tahlili
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Tasavvur qiling: abstract tayyor — “This study examines the effect of four-day weeks on productivity. 120 firms were surveyed over 18 months. Productivity rose by 8 %; sick days fell. We suggest four-day weeks benefit service sectors most.” Endi ingliz tilida yozing: birinchi — to‘rt harakatni nomi bilan sanang; ikkinchi — asosiy da’vo — bitta jumlta; uchinchi — uch gapli xulosa — “The abstract claims… Evidence is… Limitation may be…”. Baland ovozda ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Final task: for the four-day week abstract, name the four moves, state the main claim in one sentence, and write a three-sentence verdict: the claim, the evidence, and one likely limitation.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: to‘rt kunlik hafta abstract’i uchun to‘rt harakatni nomlang, asosiy da’voni bitta jumlta bilan ayting va uch gapli hukm yozing: da’vo, dalil va ehtimolli chegara.

scenes.title: Namuna tahlil: abstract’ni belgilash

examples.t: We suggest four-day weeks benefit service sectors most.
examples.uz: Biz to‘rt kunlik haftalar eng ko‘p xizmat ko‘rsatish sohalariga foyda berishini taklif qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Namuna tahlilni ko‘ring: “This study examines the effect of four-day weeks on productivity” — maqsad; “120 firms were surveyed over 18 months” — usul; “Productivity rose by 8 %; sick days fell” — natija; “We suggest four-day weeks benefit service sectors most” — takeaway — hedging bilan “we suggest”. Sizning uch gapli hukmingiz: “The abstract claims four-day weeks raise productivity. Evidence: 120 firms, 18 months, 8 % rise. Limitation likely: self-reported data and no control group.” — ikki jeysonik daqiqada professional o‘quvchi abstract’ni to‘liq tahlil qila oladi.
scenes.say: Model breakdown: aim — examine four-day weeks; method — 120 firms, 18 months; result — productivity rose eight per cent, sick days fell; takeaway — service sectors benefit most, with the cautious phrase we suggest.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna tahlil: maqsad — to‘rt kunlik haftalarni o‘rganish; usul — 120 firma, 18 oy; natija — unumdorlik sakkiz foizga oshdi, kasallik kunlari kamaydi; xulosa — xizmat sohalari eng ko‘p foyda ko‘radi — ehtiyotkor “we suggest” bilan.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Ilmiy maqolaning anatomiyasi — IMRaD va abstract; skimming — 60 soniyada umumiy ma’no; scanning — aniq faktni qidirish; dalil va da’voni ajratish; akademik lug‘at — “however”, “significant”, “volume”; hedging — “may”, “suggests” — dalilga mos ishonch. Endi har qanday ingliz tilidagi ilmiy maqola — qo‘rqinchli emas, balki tez foydali manba.
scenes.say: Today you learned the anatomy of an article, skimming and scanning, claim versus evidence, and the cautious language of academic hedging — the full toolkit for efficient reading.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun maqola anatomiyasi, skimming va scanning, dalil va da’voni ajratish, hamda akademik hedging tilini o‘rgandingiz — samarali o‘qish uchun to‘liq vositalar to‘plami.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. O‘zingiz tanlagan jurnal maqolasidan — internetda ochiq maqolalar bor — abstract va conclusion’ni tanlang va ingliz tilida 100-150 so‘zda xulosa qiling: to‘rt harakatni nomlang, asosiy da’voni ayting, dalil sifatini baholang. Keyingi darsda akademik yozuvni o‘rganamiz — bugungi o‘qish keyingi darsdagi yozuvning poydevori. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Homework: pick one open-access article, summarise its abstract and conclusion in one hundred to one hundred and fifty words — four moves, claim, evidence quality. Next lesson: academic writing. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: bitta ochiq maqola tanlang, uning abstract va conclusion’ini 100–150 so‘zda xulosa qiling — to‘rt harakat, da’vo, dalil sifati. Keyingi dars: akademik yozuv. Xayr!

homework_uz: Ochiq kirishli bitta ingliz tilidagi maqoladan abstract va conclusion’ni 100–150 so‘zda xulosa qiling — to‘rt harakat, asosiy da’vo va dalil sifati bilan. Keyingi dars: Akademik yozuv.

options: da’vo — fikr, dalil — da’voni qo‘llaydigan faktlar
quiz.why_uz: Har bir da’vodan so‘rang: qaysi dalil?
Ilmiy halollik — ishonchni dalil darajasiga moslash.
Significant — statistik ma’noda, ko‘pincha p bilan.
